'''Wadie Firestone'''<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|275|Firestone, Wadie}}</ref> was a [[Scout/Legends|Master Scout]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebellion]] and a partner of [[Arlo Tyre]].<ref name="SW Weekly 107" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="CSWE" /> both [[Gender/Legends|men]] were dispatched from headquarters<ref name="SW Weekly 107" /> to [[Alashan]]<ref name="SW Weekly 108" /> to [[Mission to Alashan|investigate]] why a Rebel [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] station had missed three routine communications.<ref name="SW Weekly 107" />

The pair found [[Death/Legends|bodies]] outside and Firestone observed that the domes appeared to have burst from the inside, despite looking as though [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] had blasted them. Tyre told him to scan for life forms, but Firestone was not hopeful that they would find any. Instead, his scan detected an energy field inside the main habitat dome that he could not identify and suggested that they call for help. Tyre disagreed and told Firestone to back him up as they investigated further. However, Tyre was soon struck by an energy beam and killed. Firestone attempted to shoot and blow up the dome without success, then launched in his modified [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing scout-fighter]], intending to get word back to the Rebel Alliance. The same mysterious energy beam blasted his ship and killed him.<ref name="SW Weekly 107" />

==Equipment==
On Alashan, Firestone carried a [[Portable scanner/Legends|porta-scanner]] and armed himself with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|rifle blaster]] and [[Proton grenade/Legends|proton grenades]]. He wore a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] with an accompanying [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]].<ref name="SW Weekly 107" />
